subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] mm/mempolicy: use vm_normal_folio_pmd() in queue_folios_pmd()

2026-09-26.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mm/mempolicy module where mbind() operations on VM_PFNMAP regions would fail due to incorrect handling of huge PMDs. The patch uses vm_normal_folio_pmd() instead of pmd_folio() to handle these cases, which also eliminates the need for separate checks for huge zero PMDs. This change allows mbind(MPOL_MF_STRICT) operations on VM_PFNMAP regions to succeed and fixes a bug that was causing crashes when trying to map MMIO BARs.
